interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_layer role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-depth respective to each other. They may also be anchored to the edges and corners of a screen and specify input handling semantics. This interface should be suitable for the implementation of many desktop shell components, and a broad number of other applications that interact with the desktop.

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer_surface from a surface

request.description:
Create a layer surface for an existing surface. This assigns the role of layer_surface, or raises a protocol error if another role is already assigned.
The layer surface will be destroyed when the surface is destroyed.
The layer shell must be destroyed after all layer surfaces are destroyed.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will not use the layer_shell object any more. Objects that have been created through this instance are not affected.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: sets the size of the surface

request.description: Sets the size of the surface in surface-local coordinates. The compositor will display the surface centered with respect to its anchors.

request.name: set_anchor

description.summary: configures the anchor point of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor anchor the surface to the specified edges and corners. If two orthogonal edges are specified (e.g. 'top' and 'left'), then the anchor point will be the intersection of the edges (e.g. the top left corner of the output); otherwise the anchor point will be centered on that edge, or in the center if none is specified.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone

description.summary: configures the exclusive zone of this surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor avoids occluding an area of the screen with other surfaces. The compositor's use of this information is implementation-dependent - do not assume that this region will not actually be occluded.

description.summary: sets a margin from the anchor point

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client commits the surface in response to the configure event, then the client must make an ack_configure request sometime before the commit request, passing along the serial of the configure event.

event.name: configure
event.description:
The configure event asks the client to resize its surface.
The size is a hint, in the sense that the client is free to ignore it if it doesn't resize, pick a smaller size (to satisfy aspect ratio or other constraints), or pick a larger size.

event.name: closed
event.description: The closed event is sent by the compositor when the surface will no longer be shown. The output may have been destroyed or the user may have asked for it to be removed. Further changes to the surface will be ignored. The client should destroy the resource after receiving this event, and create a new surface if they so choose.
